description: solveTruss analyses planar and spatial truss structures using Mathematica notebooks. The contributors publish separate two-dimensional and three-dimensional versions for static response, global buckling and vibration frequency calculations. Users define joints, members, section and material properties, supports and loads. Results describe the chosen structure at its specified dimensions; the notebooks supply no fixed place, time series or network dataset. A modeller can use the analyses for preliminary checks of bridge or building truss components under load. The public notebooks are free under GPL-3.0, stated in the repository licence. Wolfram Mathematica is a separate proprietary runtime whose access and price were not checked in this review. A limitation is that idealised truss members and global buckling results do not replace detailed connection and local failure checks. No related catalogue record was identified. No structural example, notebook or licensed runtime was executed.
